notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI's quest log (Program.Quest.cs, log mode of the shared quest window) exists with the UI-QuestLog book art, title, 'n / 20' count, six selectable title rows, a detail area with quest title + objectives text, and working Abandon (CMSG_QUESTLOG_REMOVE_QUEST) and Close buttons. Registry's 13/13 opcodes are about the wire, not the window - the list and detail panes are far thinner than the reference/Benilla.
